## Project

Name the affected `projects/<name>/` folder or root infrastructure.

## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest behavior change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the affected project's tests.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and `npm test` from the repository root.
- [ ] I ran `npm run verify` for repository-wide changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation or screenshots when user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I confirmed no secrets, private data, or generated reports were added.
